outcome_branch: early rejection at performance-leadership.md section 6 step 2: application delay overlapped with a later Fetch is below 1% of nb-fetch-appdelay; remaining implementation criteria do not apply
hypothesis: While the application sleeps after a returned batch, the next Fetch is still idle. Starting that Fetch before fetch returns would hide broker wait behind the 1 ms nb-fetch-appdelay pause and raise records/s.
finding: One parent run of nb-fetch-appdelay performed 1 fetch round, fetched 135000 records, and consumed the 20000-record target from that response. Measured duration was 0.174219 s. The configured 1 ms batch delay therefore occurs once, after the only Fetch, and is 0.57% of wall time. No subsequent round exists for a prefetch to overlap. Client CPU was 54.632 ms for the round. No production code was changed.
